goal: Implement faithful deterministic source range geometry and internal/prior-RTH location publication, with all source alternatives preserved and bounded relation facts; learned roles and empirical source statistics are separate dependencies.

ports.name: RangeDefinition
ports.rules: Immutable. geometry_kind distinguishes wick/sessionOC/body-envelope/fixed-extension/statistical population; unknown source formula carries unresolved status, never arbitrary default. Definitions include no display style.

ports.name: RangeEvidence
ports.rules: Use current F09 SharedBarEngine retained factory publication for exact F03 formation interval/raw domain. A hand-built SharedBar, activity finality, quote bars or coarse straddling bars cannot certify a clock range. Certified available(...,final_only=True) is necessary, not sufficient: require timekind/statefinal/complete support/aligned endpoint and domain; then gate each output by its own requiredfields. General provisional path explicitly requests provisional evidence.

ports.name: RangeVersion
ports.rules: No OHLC fill from missing or ambiguous edge. Preserve per-field supported facts. Exact completed H/L and positiveW suffice for E0 current6–9 geometry; range-open needsO, priorE0 four-reference set needs allOHLC. Width-percent normalization may be unavailable when its declared denominator is unsupported. Revisions append; old geometry and target birth bindings remain immutable.

ports.name: RangeRelation
ports.rules: Known at max parent availability. Separate shared-time versus price overlap. No automatic merge or independent vote. Use rational coordinates and versioned graph facts.

ports.name: LocationProposal
ports.rules: Quarter/EQ/range-open are separate general L01 objects. MinimalE0 adapter emits only nine6–9 geometry objects plus four priorRTH M12 facts. No mandatory gamma/Response or edge-first role rule; fixedE0 fade policy belongs outside generator.

ports.name: RegistryAdapter
fields: candidate cut and target birth binding
ports.rules: Target modern ObjectGraph public API, not a second mutable registry. Adapter must validate underlying F09 factory evidence and exact source lineage; merely wrapping arbitrary OHLC into registry evidence is insufficient. Preserve overlaps and use action alias projection only at policy layer.

source_scope.closure_rule: Each route gets one of exact_source_adapter_assertion, source_defect_comparator_assertion, provenance_or_dependency_assertion, or explicit_unresolved_definition_gate, plus exact original extent proof. Marking a source gated is not empirical rejection or component completion.

complexity_and_retention.proposal: Bound max registered windows, source events/publications, range versions, relation pairs and candidate cuts in a reviewed protocol. Use shared F09 summaries; do not scan historical tape per candidate. Publish relation updates only for changed parents. Fail or explicitly archive at declared retention bounds, never silently evict failures.
complexity_and_retention.measurement: Instrument source rows visited, aggregate summaries reused, relation pairs evaluated, versions written, candidates enumerated, checkpoint bytes, wall/CPU and RSS. Exact operation counts are engineering claims, not latency promises.

open_design_items_before_registration: Root registration is the remaining gate; no candidate implementation/import/compile/test has occurred.
foundation_baseline: Root reports shared F09–F12 first run passed563 with zero errors/failures/skips. This report does not independently execute or change that evidence. New imports/runs require a fresh root-reviewed registration.

ClockSelection.contract: F03-derived immutable named half-open interval; no custom consumer clock recomputation or assumed prior calendar date. Different NY/fixedEST/partial windows are different variants.

RangePrimitive.contract: Thin typed projection from actual certified F09 SharedBar plus exact F03 and source/anchor parents. Whole-bar order_exact is not required for H/L or provable first/last prices. Preserve independently supported OHLC fields and ambiguity; no invented fill. E0 current06–09 nine geometry objects need complete H/L and positiveW. PriorE0 complete four-reference set needs O/H/L/C; supported individual prior references remain diagnostic/broader objects when the complete set is unavailable. Raw lifetime, first/last times, support reasons and expiry/horizon are explicit or reachable through exact immutable parents.

shared_port_proposal.ownership: Root assigns /root/f04_scheduler_tests sole ownership of new foundations/range_primitives.py and context/range_adapter.py. /root/f04_batch_review owns M12 prior selection and L02/L03 consumer modules only; it consumes these APIs and does not edit neutral/adapter modules. All edits remain prohibited until root registration.

properties: raw lifetime and tick size from instrument
ClockSelection.contract: Resolve actual Calendar at cut, validate actual available IntervalGraph and named node known at cut, exactly one span and trading_dates==(requested date,), derive FormationWindow from this span. Retain graph and node content versions. Raw instrument root binding and lifetime required. Calendar.resolve session is separately retained; 06–09 is not required to be within RTH. Compile source WallRule using byte-versioned zone_version for America/New_York or Etc/GMT+5; never treat a label as an exact UTC clock. M12 attests prior relationship separately.

FieldSupport.contract: observed means complete exact support for that requested field; partial/ambiguous/empty/unavailable cannot be silently cast to observed.

RangePrimitive.contract: No detached primitive certifies itself. Adapter returns typed unsupported diagnostics, with supported fields only in primary OHLC and first/last observed prices only in observed_ohlc. Missing opening coverage returns open_ticks=None and support reason incomplete_open even when first observed price exists. Private factory receipt/capability refers to actual retained F09 publication; it is not a caller boolean and is re-established from restored engine before registry publication. Raw lifetime comes from selection.instrument; horizon/expiry remain explicit downstream definition and registry policy, never inferred from source post.

RangeRegistryLinks.contract: Source and anchor IDs derive stable clock identity. Evidence and anchor version IDs derive primitive content plus explicit independent registry revision/predecessors. Initial links revision 0 even if F09 bar revision is greater; next links require previous exact links. Writer verifies source identity and actual predecessor. Retry reuses identical links.

RangePublicationReceipt.contract: Only returned after actual ObjectGraph atomic commit succeeds. No partial successful receipt on rejected batch.

functions.signature: select_clock(*, calendar: Calendar, interval_graph: IntervalGraph, interval_name: str, trading_date: date, instrument_root: str, instrument: Instrument, cut: int) -> ClockSelection
functions.contract: Resolve actual Calendar at cut, validate actual available IntervalGraph and named node known at cut, exactly one span and trading_dates==(requested date,), derive FormationWindow from this span. Retain graph and node content versions. Raw instrument root binding and lifetime required. Calendar.resolve session is separately retained; 06–09 is not required to be within RTH. Compile source WallRule using byte-versioned zone_version for America/New_York or Etc/GMT+5; never treat a label as an exact UTC clock. M12 attests prior relationship separately.

functions.signature: primitive_from_shared_bar(*, selection: ClockSelection, engine: SharedBarEngine, publication_version_id: str, cut: int) -> RangePrimitive
functions.contract: Look up exact retained factory publication in actual engine.publications. Require publication.available(cut,final_only=False), actual certification and compatible timekind/domain/interval/calendar/reset. Never accepts arbitrary bar argument. Produce provisional/incomplete/empty diagnostics without promoting unsupported values. Complete H/L support does not depend on O/C/interior order. Published finality and coverage are checked separately. One selected primitive does not select a raw contract or calendar predecessor. Resolve the exact immutable bar/request pair through engine.window_publication; never copy or scan checkpoint history. Derive endpoint coverage from request.coverage.observed_intervals, full H/L from complete coverage/history/priced volume and finality; order ambiguity affects only fields whose endpoint price is ambiguous.

functions.signature: primitive_registry_links(primitive: RangePrimitive, *, previous: RangeRegistryLinks | None = None) -> RangeRegistryLinks
functions.contract: Source and anchor IDs derive stable clock identity. Evidence and anchor version IDs derive primitive content plus explicit independent registry revision/predecessors. Initial links revision 0 even if F09 bar revision is greater; next links require previous exact links. Writer verifies source identity and actual predecessor. Retry reuses identical links.

functions.signature: publish_range_batch(*, graph: ObjectGraph, primitives: tuple[RangePrimitive, ...], registry_links: tuple[RangeRegistryLinks, ...], derived_members: tuple[DerivedRangeMember, ...], batch_id: str, batch_sequence: int, clocks: PublicationClock, expected_head: str | None) -> RangePublicationReceipt
functions.contract: Revalidate actual factory provenance and scalar projection, one exact supplied link per primitive, independent revision/predecessor and per-formula field requirements. Materialize EvidenceVersion/AnchorVersion at the original source availability; commit these and typed derived members through actual AtomicBatch with caller-frozen sequence and expected_head. Reattempts reuse exact sequence/links/recipe and actual F10 idempotence. No batch_sequence default. Future evidence, forged links or insufficient field activation rejects entire batch; no successful partial receipt. Preserve original F09 publication/revision/correction content in primitive metadata and evidence content_digest; registry ordinal is independent. Existing F10 handles candidate cuts, visits, targets and aliases. Before mutation validate actual retained predecessor/source identity and causal availability. A caller-chosen previous receipt cannot roll a source stream backward or skip a retained correction. At publication cut reconcile intervening retained F09 source versions/correction lineage with the selected primitive; any unaccounted known correction rejects activation. Historical publication remains queried through original cuts rather than republished as current.

public_api_contract.anchor_revision_rule: ROOT FROZEN: BirthKey.anchors=() and stable source_origins plus generator discriminator; each ObjectRevision binds current exact evidence and parent object versions. Emit current AnchorVersion plus explicit SHARED_EVIDENCE relation metadata (anchor endpoints cannot be ancestry PARENT endpoints). A relation whose endpoints change gets a new relation identity. Provisional anchor end is observed prefix <= confirmation, never future formation end. Existing target geometry and original frozen candidate versions are immutable.

f09_minimal_extension.returns: actual retained certified time SharedBar and exact frozen WindowRequest used to publish it
f09_minimal_extension.implementation_plan: Maintain version-indexed private immutable pair on successful publish_window; O(1) lookup, O(publications) retained references bounded by max_publications. Restore rebuilds index through the existing verified publication replay; checkpoint schema unchanged. No whole-history scan, no checkpoint serialization per primitive. Unknown or activity-result version raises DependencyUnavailable; malformed ID raises ContractError. No unregistered candidate changes.

pending_writer_details.status: Root approved exact concrete links and wrapper signatures; no remaining API design gap.
pending_writer_details.revision_metadata: Full immutable primitive payload remains the typed receipt; evidence.content_digest binds it. F10 EvidenceVersion has no arbitrary metadata field. AnchorVersion payload and explicit relations use existing legal F10 fields only.

DerivedRangeMember.contract: Every derived ObjectRevision has exact required field bindings for its formula and complete source/parent closure. Allowed fields O/H/L/C in canonical names open/high/low/close, nonempty per primitive. Writer rejects eligible activation unless each named field is observed in that certified primitive. Relations have empty requirements and bind checked exact endpoints; do not grant eligibility. Definition-specific field bindings must equal registered formula dependency table, not arbitrary caller under-declaration.

normalization_policy.width_price_percent: W / available nonzero range open; exact rational. Unsupported or zero O leaves percent unavailable only, not H/L abstention.
normalization_policy.width_prior_volatility: positive preceding completed available scale at frozen cut; missing/nonpositive/unavailable leaves ratio unavailable; no learned fallback.
